notes.note: Reviewed Windows runtime destination handling at 09fc618d14 against the staging caller, generated Tauri resource overlay and NSIS hook. Frontend remains a production dist-ui build; external backend packages preserve realpath identities and resolve through shallow safe ancestors. Updated desktop-build/native-releases; nightly and README remain accurate channel/entrypoint descriptions, not signed artifact guarantees. Independent production-export boundary and mutation probes passed; full signed Tauri UI install and MSI custom-root enforcement are not verified. Hook checked before its own cleanup, not before the stock template's prior-version uninstaller.
